earlier_identifications: Earlier public TESS-SPOC full-frame threshold-crossing events; earlier Villanova target entry marked outside the EB catalogue
interpretation: Unequal alternating eclipses in five sectors. WISE reported variability at 0.4512575 d. Villanova lists the target outside its EB catalogue without an ephemeris.

references.2023ApJS..264...17Z: Stellar Parameters and Spectroscopic Properties of TESS Objects Observed in the LAMOST Low- and Medium-resolution Spectral Survey.
